description: Rename a company-scoped API key or replace its permissions in place, without issuing a new key. Use this when a call fails with a missing-scope error: the key value stays the same, so no client has to be re-wired, and added permissions apply on the next retry. Removed permissions may remain usable for up to five minutes while API caches expire. preset and scopes REPLACE the current selection rather than merging into it - call list_api_keys first and pass the full set you want. Returns non-secret metadata only.

apiKeyId.description: Exact API key ID returned by list_api_keys

companyId.description: Company ID that owns the API key

name.description: New human-readable name for the key

preset.description: Replacement permission preset. Supported values: full_access, read_only, agent_safe, ai_drafting, data_ingest_safe, data_ingest_automations, transactional_sender, marketing_sender.

scopes.description: Replacement explicit permission scopes. Overrides preset and must include at least one supported scope.

name: update_api_key

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `update_api_key` MCP tool.

apiKey.description: The updated non-secret API key metadata, including the `scopes` now in effect (null when the key has full access) record returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
